articles.title: Fifth-generation Kanoo group member is moving a $6 trillion trade market onto blockchain rails
articles.snippet: Abdulla Kanoo says his ARP Digital firm is building settlement infrastructure for the growing flow of trade between emerging economies, a market that could reach $32 trillion by 2030.

articles.title: CoinMENA, Standard Chartered partner on UAE payment rails
articles.snippet: CoinMENA will use Standard Chartered to strengthen fiat payment rails in the UAE, while Revolut reportedly secured central bank licenses ahead of a planned local launch.
